question: Why is the deity praised as Bhairava in the scripture?
premises: He is the lord of the goddess groups described earlier.
He is greatly terrifying because he shatters the course of worldly existence.
Teachers praise him in scripture through such etymological meanings.
inference: The name Bhairava is explained theologically as the lord who is terrifying in breaking the cycle of worldly existence.
plain_english: As the lord of that group, greatly terrifying in shattering the course of worldly existence, he is praised in the scripture by the teachers with these etymological meanings as Bhairava.
